richiami.difetto: If the vehicle is washed with a high-pressure cleaner, water may enter the interior, damage the control device for the tailgate and cause an incomplete short circuit with localised damage from scorching. When air enters through open windows, doors, or the sliding roof, the damage from scorching can develop into a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Manufacturer · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: Unknown
